episodes.title: The Legend of Tham Luang
episodes.summary: The Wild Boars soccer team meet for practice with plans to explore a cave afterwards. Little do they know that their lives are about to change forever.

episodes.title: To Not Offend the Gods
episodes.summary: Coach Ek and the boys realize they're trapped inside the cave due to rising water levels. The clock is ticking as rescue efforts begin to ramp up.

episodes.title: The Princess' Chalice
episodes.summary: A hydraulic engineer warns of the drastically rising waters. Meanwhile, rescuers deliver food supplies and family letters to the hopeful boys.

episodes.title: Lucky Baht
episodes.summary: The rescue team works out the best way to safely retrieve the boys from the cave — but an unfortunate tragedy strikes during the operation.

episodes.title: The Parable of Kisa Gotami
episodes.summary: Governor Narongsak makes an effort to get consent from the boys' families to proceed with a new but contentious rescue plan.

episodes.title: Moo Pa
episodes.summary: Against all odds, the day has come for the rescue divers to finally extract the boys from the cave — and the world is watching in anticipation.
